mapper.select: SELECT S.STAY_ID, S.BIZ_NO, S.NAME, S.PHONE, S.ZIP_CODE, S.ADDR, S.ADDR_DETAIL, S.DESCRIPTION, S.LAT, S.LNG, S.CHECK_IN, S.CHECK_OUT, S.PET_POLICY, S.REFUND_POLICY, S.FACILITIES, S.PET_FEE FROM TB_STAY S JOIN TB_BUSINESS B ON S.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO WHERE B.BIZ_ID = #{bizId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_STAY ( STAY_ID, BIZ_NO, MEMBER_NO, NAME, PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDR, ADDR_DETAIL, REGION, APPROVE_DATE, STATUS_CD ) SELECT (SELECT NVL(MAX(STAY_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TB_STAY), B.BIZ_NO, (SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = B.BIZ_ID OR EMAIL = B.BIZ_ID FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY), B.BIZ_NAME, B.PHONE, B.ZIP_CODE, B.ADDR, B.ADDR_DETAIL, CASE WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%서울%' THEN '서울' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%경기%' THEN '경기' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%인천%' THEN '인천' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%강원%' THEN '강원' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%제주%' THEN '제주' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%부산%' THEN '부산' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%대구%' THEN '대구' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%울산%' THEN '울산' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%광주%' THEN '광주' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%대전%' THEN '대전' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%세종%' THEN '세종' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%경상%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%경북%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%경남%' THEN '경상' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%전라%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%전북%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%전남%' THEN '전라' WHEN B.ADDR LIKE '%충청%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%충북%' OR B.ADDR LIKE '%충남%' THEN '충청' ELSE '기타' END, SYSDATE, 'ACTIVE' FROM TB_BUSINESS B WHERE B.BIZ_ID = #{bizId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_STAY S WHERE S.BIZ_NO = B.BIZ_NO )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_STAY SET CHECK_IN = #{checkIn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CHECK_OUT = #{checkOut, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESCRIPTION = #{description, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAT = #{lat, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, LNG = #{lng, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, PET_FEE = #{petFee, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, PET_POLICY = #{petPolicy, jdbcType=CLOB}, REFUND_POLICY = #{refundPolicy, jdbcType=CLOB}, FACILITIES = #{facilities, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId}
mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_ID, STAY_ID, NAME, PRICE_PER_NIGHT, CAPACITY, PET_LIMIT, STATUS_CD, REJECT_REASON FROM TB_STAY_ROOM WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY ROOM_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND STATUS_CD IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKIN', 'CHECKOUT')

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.PET_ID AS petId, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.PET_CNT AS petCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies, P.BREED AS petBreed, P.AGE AS petAge, S.NAME AS stayName, S.ADDR AS stayAddr, SR.NAME AS roomName FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId})
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'PENDING'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CHECKIN'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CHECKOUT'
AND R.STATUS_CD = 'DONE'
AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')
ORDER BY R.RESV_DATE DESC, R.RESV_TIME DESC, R.RESV_ID DESC

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.RESV_TYPE AS resvType, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.PET_ID AS petId, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.SYMPTOMS AS symptoms, R.REQUEST_MEMO AS requestMemo, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.PET_CNT AS petCnt, R.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS totalAmount, R.ROOM_ID AS roomId, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies, P.BREED AS petBreed, P.AGE AS petAge, S.NAME AS stayName, S.ADDR AS stayAddr, SR.NAME AS roomName FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY S ON R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND S.STAY_ID = TO_NUMBER(R.TARGET_ID) WHERE R.RESV_ID = #{resvId} AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId}) AND R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY'

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RESV_NO AS resvNo, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, R.NIGHT_CNT AS nightCnt, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, P.PET_NAME AS petName, SR.NAME AS serviceName FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId}) AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKIN', 'CHECKOUT', 'DONE') AND R.CHECKOUT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND R.CHECKIN_DATE < TO_DATE(#{toDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 ORDER BY R.CHECKIN_DATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION R WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId}) AND R.STATUS_CD IN ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION R WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId}) AND R.STATUS_CD = 'CONFIRMED' AND R.RESV_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND R.RESV_DATE < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1

SELECT COUPON_ID, COUPON_CODE, COUPON_NAME, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_VALUE, MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, MIN_ORDER_AMT, TOTAL_BUDGET, ISSUED_BUDGET, TOTAL_QTY, ISSUED_QTY, USE_START_DATE, USE_END_DATE, BIZ_MEMBER_NO, APPROVAL_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, APPROVAL_DATE, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE, MOD_DATE FROM TB_COUPON WHERE BIZ_MEMBER_NO = #{bizMemberNo} ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

SELECT COUPON_ID, COUPON_CODE, COUPON_NAME, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_VALUE, MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, MIN_ORDER_AMT, TOTAL_BUDGET, ISSUED_BUDGET, TOTAL_QTY, ISSUED_QTY, USE_START_DATE, USE_END_DATE, BIZ_MEMBER_NO, APPROVAL_STATUS, REJECT_REASON, APPROVAL_DATE, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE, MOD_DATE FROM TB_COUPON WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COUPON ( COUPON_ID, COUPON_CODE, COUPON_NAME, COUPON_TYPE, DISCOUNT_VALUE, MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT, MIN_ORDER_AMT, TOTAL_BUDGET, ISSUED_BUDGET, TOTAL_QTY, ISSUED_QTY, USE_START_DATE, USE_END_DATE, BIZ_MEMBER_NO, BIZ_NO, APPROVAL_STATUS, STATUS_CD, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_COUPON.NEXTVAL, #{couponCode}, #{couponName}, #{couponType}, #{discountValue}, #{maxDiscountAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{minOrderAmt}, #{totalBudget}, #{issuedBudget}, #{totalQty}, #{issuedQty}, #{useStartDate}, #{useEndDate}, #{bizMemberNo}, #{bizMemberNo}, #{approvalStatus}, #{statusCd}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_COUPON SET COUPON_NAME = #{couponName}, COUPON_TYPE = #{couponType}, DISCOUNT_VALUE = #{discountValue}, MAX_DISCOUNT_AMT = #{maxDiscountAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MIN_ORDER_AMT = #{minOrderAmt}, TOTAL_BUDGET = #{totalBudget}, TOTAL_QTY = #{totalQty}, USE_START_DATE = #{useStartDate}, USE_END_DATE = #{useEndDate}, MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND BIZ_MEMBER_NO = #{bizMemberNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TB_COUPON SET STATUS_CD = 'INACTIVE', MOD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE COUPON_ID = #{couponId} AND BIZ_MEMBER_NO = #{bizMemberNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND STATUS_CD = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT BIZ_NO FROM TB_BUSINESS WHERE BIZ_ID = #{bizId}
mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN TB_FILE f ON f.FILE_ID = b.FILE_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT b.BANNER_ID, b.BIZ_NO, b.TITLE, b.LINK_URL, b.POSITION_CD, TO_CHAR(b.START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(b.END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, b.STATUS_CD, b.REJECT_REASON, b.REG_DATE, f.FILE_URL AS imageUrl FROM TB_BANNER b
WHERE b.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} ORDER BY b.REG_DATE DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TB_BANNER.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_BANNER ( BANNER_ID, BIZ_NO, TITLE, LINK_URL, POSITION_CD, FILE_ID, START_DATE, END_DATE, STATUS_CD ) VALUES ( #{bannerId}, #{bizNo}, #{title}, #{linkUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{positionCd}, #{fileId}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), NVL(#{statusCd}, 'PENDING') )
mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.BIZ_REPLY AS bizReply, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS petSpecies FROM TB_REVIEW R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_RESERVATION RV ON RV.RESV_ID = R.RESV_ID LEFT JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = RV.PET_ID WHERE R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY R.REG_DATE DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.TARGET_ID AS targetId, R.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.BIZ_REPLY AS bizReply, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname FROM TB_REVIEW R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = #{stayId} AND R.REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST ( REQUEST_ID, REVIEW_ID, REVIEW_TYPE, TARGET_ID, BIZ_NO, REQUEST_REASON, STATUS_CD, REQ_DATE ) VALUES ( #{requestId}, #{reviewId}, #{reviewType}, #{targetId}, #{bizNo}, #{requestReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{statusCd}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT DR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, DR.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, DR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, DR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, DR.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, DR.REQ_DATE AS reqDate, DR.PROCESS_DATE AS processDate, M.NICKNAME AS reviewerNickname, R.RATING AS reviewRating, R.CONTENT AS reviewContent FROM TB_REVIEW_DELETE_REQUEST DR LEFT JOIN TB_REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_ID = DR.REVIEW_ID AND R.REVIEW_TYPE = DR.REVIEW_TYPE LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO WHERE DR.TARGET_ID = #{stayId} AND DR.BIZ_NO = #{bizNo} AND DR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' ORDER BY DR.REQ_DATE DESC, DR.REQUEST_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{targetId}) AND TRUNC(CHECKIN_DATE) = TO_DATE(#{dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{targetId}) AND TRUNC(CHECKOUT_DATE) = TO_DATE(#{dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED')

SELECT NVL(SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{targetId}) AND STATUS_CD IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CHECKIN', 'CHECKOUT', 'DONE') AND CHECKIN_DATE >= TRUNC(TO_DATE(#{dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'MM') AND CHECKIN_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{dt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
SELECT STATUS_CD AS "STATUS_CD", COUNT(*) AS "CNT" FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{targetId}) AND CHECKIN_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') GROUP BY STATUS_CD

SELECT TO_CHAR(D.DT, 'MM-DD') AS dt, NVL(R.CNT, 0) AS resvCount, NVL(R.REV, 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL - 1) AS DT FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= #{days} ) D LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRUNC(CHECKIN_DATE) AS RD, COUNT(*) AS CNT, NVL(SUM(TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS REV FROM TB_RESERVATION WHERE RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{targetId}) AND STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED') AND CHECKIN_DATE >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - #{days} + 1 GROUP BY TRUNC(CHECKIN_DATE) ) R ON R.RD = D.DT ORDER BY D.DT

SELECT R.RESV_ID AS resvId, R.STATUS_CD AS statusCd, R.CHECKIN_DATE AS checkinDate, R.CHECKOUT_DATE AS checkoutDate, M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.BREED AS petBreed, SR.NAME AS roomName FROM TB_RESERVATION R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_PET P ON P.PET_ID = R.PET_ID LEFT JOIN TB_STAY_ROOM SR ON SR.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID WHERE R.RESV_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = TO_CHAR(#{stayId}) AND TRUNC(R.CHECKIN_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND R.STATUS_CD NOT IN ('CANCEL', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY R.CHECKIN_DATE FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.RATING AS rating, R.CONTENT AS content, R.REG_DATE AS regDate, M.NICKNAME AS nickname FROM TB_REVIEW R JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO WHERE R.REVIEW_TYPE = 'STAY' AND R.TARGET_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY R.REG_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
